baseline.description: No change: keep the current setup
baseline.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a Electric water filter dispenser. A countertop dispenser made of a transparent water tank, a tank lid and a water pumping unit; the pumping unit holds a circuit board, a battery and a carbon block filter element. The Electric water filter dispenser is assembled in China using components sourced from South Korea and China.

The carbon block are produced in South Korea. The filter element housing parts, transparent water tank and tank lid and water pumping unit with circuit board, battery and touch panel are produced in China. 

Final assembly in China: assemble the filter element, fit it into the pumping unit, fit the pumping unit to the tank and lid, test and pack.

prediction.decisive_step: Manufacturing of the carbon block in South Korea
prediction.reasoning: Following CBP precedents N347698 and N348710, the essential character of a water filtration device is imparted by the carbon block, which performs the core purifying function via adsorption. Although the tank, lid, and electric pumping unit (with PCB and battery) are produced in China, combining them with the filter element in China is a simple assembly operation that does not substantially transform the South Korean carbon block.

key_factors: South Korean carbon block and water pumping unit
prediction.decisive_step: Manufacturing of the carbon block, water pumping unit, and water tank in South Korea
prediction.reasoning: Following CBP precedent in N347698, N348710, and N347101, the carbon block imparts the essential character to water filtration systems. Furthermore, here the water pumping unit (including circuit board, battery, and touch panel) and the water tank are also manufactured in South Korea. The processing in China is limited to producing the plastic filter housing parts and performing simple final assembly and testing, which does not substantially transform the South Korean core components.

verdict.reasoning: In Variant A, CBP held origin was China because, unlike passive water filter tanks (N347698) where the South Korean carbon block imparted the essential character, the electric dispenser's water pumping unit (with circuit board, battery, and touch panel) and tank were produced in China. In Variant B, production of the pumping unit, electronics, tank, and lid moves to South Korea, leaving only plastic filter element housing parts and simple final assembly/fitting in China. As seen in N347698 and N348086, simple filter element gluing/welding and tank fitting in China does not substantially transform the South Korean core components.
